metadata.target_role: Senior Product Manager (Sage Intacct Budgeting & Planning)

profile_summary: Enterprise Product and Strategy leader with 10+ years of experience across B2B enterprise platforms, SaaS product delivery, financial and business operations, and GTM execution. Proven ability to partner with Finance, Business Operations, IT Operations, Engineering, and Product Marketing teams to translate workflow research and customer needs into agile product roadmaps, P&L-aligned investment priorities, and scalable solutions. Strong track record in forecasting, budgeting, and ROI governance alongside shipping AI-enabled workflow agents, unified asset lifecycle platforms ($2M annual savings), and 99.99% reliability systems.

sub_bullets: Owned and drove cross-functional enterprise platform initiatives across engineering, IT operations, and business teams by defining agile product requirements and release governance, ensuring 99.99% reliability for core business platforms

Designed KPI frameworks and executive dashboards tracking incident resolution, cost savings, platform adoption, and operational efficiency by aligning engineering and business metrics, defining annual and quarterly roadmaps targeting a 20% reduction in incident volume
Managed forecasting, budgeting, headcount planning, and P&L governance across product initiatives by partnering with finance and executive stakeholders on ROI-driven roadmap prioritization
Led strategic revenue-protection initiatives that reduced order cancellations by deploying automated recovery agents and incident handling workflows across operations, saving ~$10M annually
Coordinated cross-functional initiatives across product, engineering, finance, and IT operations by translating business workflow research into prioritized enhancements, driving enterprise alignment
Partnered with finance, operations, and IT stakeholders to govern end-to-end operational planning, procurement, and lifecycle workflows across enterprise business units

Spearheaded a unified enterprise asset lifecycle platform by partnering with finance, IT operations, and business operations stakeholders to streamline provisioning and lifecycle visibility, delivering ~$2M in annual cost savings

Designed and launched an AI-driven procurement and catalog system using intelligent workflow agents to automate store setup onboarding and operational coordination, reducing operational cycle times by 20%
